_comment: Copy-fill blocks for the framing dialogue (dialogue.md). Every human decision goes through AskUserQuestion; each option label maps 1:1 to a downstream action. These are EXAMPLES — regenerate options to fit the actual request; never print a choice as plain text and wait.

questions.question: What is this inquiry really after? (sets what counts as evidence — paradigm lens, not a label to commit to)

options.label: Regularity / measurement
options.description: An objective, measurable pattern → positivist–postpositivist; design toward measurement/test (methodology.md).

options.label: Meaning / lived experience
options.description: How people interpret/experience it → interpretivist/constructivist/phenomenological; design toward interpretation.

options.label: Underlying mechanism
options.description: Why/how it is generated → critical realist; design toward explaining the generative mechanism.

options.label: What works in practice
options.description: Resolve a practical problem → pragmatist/mixed; whatever method-mix best answers it.

options.label: Power / change
options.description: Who is harmed and how to change it → critical/transformative/decolonial; judged by emancipatory value.

questions.question: Here is the framed question + ≥2 candidate directions + the critical assumptions to test first. Proceed, or redirect?

options.label: Proceed to DESIGN
options.description: Frame is right → run methodology.md (plan) or go straight to ROUTE/COLLECT.

options.label: Adjust scope/purpose
options.description: Reopen Stage 2–4 (purpose, scope, unit) before designing.

options.label: Change direction
options.description: Reopen Stage 5 (the paradigm lens) — wrong kind of evidence.

options.label: Stop — not answerable
options.description: Negative condition is already met → report NEEDLE NOT FOUND with what would make it answerable.
